entities.name: Luis Hurtado de Mendoza y Pacheco
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Hurtado de Mendoza y Pacheco, 3rd Count of Tendilla and the 2nd Marquis of Mondéjar, was a Spanish nobleman in the service of Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor. He was Captain General of Granada and Viceroy of Navarre in 1543–1546.
